newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil debt/GDP ratio stabilizing - Central Bank.
newsitem.headline: Brazil debt/GDP ratio stabilizing - Central Bank.

text.p: Brazil's net public sector debt-to-GDP ratio is showing signs of stabilizing around its current 35 percent mark, a Central Bank official said.
"The trend is towards stabilization," Altamir Lopes, head of the bank's economic department, told reporters.

Central Bank data released Monday put Brazil net public sector debt at 252.701 billion reais, or 35 percent of gross domestic product. In July, the ratio was 34.7 percent, in June 34.3 percent and in May 33.4 percent.
The principal cause behind the sharp increase in the debt-GDP ratio since December, when it measured 31.2 percent, was the government's policy of keeping interest rates high, Lopes said.
